transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Voicemail support desk, agent 202.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Reuben Gallagher. I run a commercial plumbing and heating consultancy, and ever since S-Net upgraded its mobile voicemail system over the weekend, my professional business greeting has disappeared: callers now get a tinny synthesized robotic voice saying 'You have reached 07700 900882', which sounds completely unprofessional and makes clients think my business has closed down!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect your cellular voicemail profile. What mobile telephone number is registered to this voicemail box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is 07700 900882, registered to 12 Station Road, Carlisle, CA1 1RD, security PIN 3310.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that brings up the voicemail account record. What happens when you dial 1571 to record a new custom greeting?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I dial 1571, record my professional greeting, press hash to save, and the automated voice confirms 'Greeting saved successfully', but when anyone calls my mobile, it continues playing the robotic number greeting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the central voicemail media server database?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The media gateway indicates that your subscriber mailbox has a corrupted pointer record linking the subscriber profile to the audio storage partition.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you repair that pointer record so the system plays the custom greeting I recorded?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline representatives do not have access to edit raw database pointer records on the central media storage architecture.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then how do I get my professional business greeting to play for my customers?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you run an independent commercial trade business, you should be subscribing to our business mobile plan rather than using a standard consumer retail SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have had this exact same number for seven years and paid you every month! Don't tell me what tariff I should buy when your system corrupted my greeting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating our service level agreement distinctions between consumer retail and business accounts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you escalate this to a database engineer who can fix the media pointer?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Database support escalations can be submitted through our server maintenance portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still there? The phone went completely dead for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was accessing the regional telecommunications server maintenance queue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can the server maintenance team fix the pointer today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously voicemail audio partitions operate on centralized distributed file systems that sync during scheduled maintenance windows.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need my business greeting working during trading hours, not in the middle of the night!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have lost two boiler installation contracts worth eight thousand pounds this morning because prospective clients called my number, heard that synthesized robot voice, and hung up thinking my company was a fraudulent shell operation! Eight thousand pounds of work lost because S-Net corrupted my voicemail! I am shaking with fury and facing financial disaster!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how intensely furious and devastating it is to lose eight thousand pounds in client contracts this morning over a synthesized robot greeting, and the immense financial stress this has caused your trade business. Having prospective clients turn away because of a corrupted voicemail pointer is completely unacceptable, and I will submit an emergency server re-sync ticket immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can they fix the pointer before the end of business today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Server maintenance teams review database sync queues during our overnight batch cycle at two in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the robot voice will continue turning away clients for the rest of today?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, active database partition pointer corrections cannot be executed on live daytime server nodes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any temporary workaround I can use so callers don't hear the robot?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can disable voicemail call forwarding on your mobile handset by dialing hash hash zero zero two hash.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if I dial hash hash zero zero two hash?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Unanswered calls will ring out rather than diverting to the corrupted voicemail robot, allowing you to return missed calls from your call log.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing hash hash zero zero two hash now... Phone displays: 'All conditional call forwarding disabled'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Callers will now hear standard ringing tones and will not be greeted by the robotic prompt.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is better than a robot telling them my number doesn't exist, but it doesn't solve my voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Did you disconnect? Why is there zero background sound on this call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was logging your server escalation under technical ticket VM-DB-88192-K.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: VM-DB-88192-K, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The overnight batch script will purge the corrupted pointer and rebuild your mailbox index at two in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So tomorrow morning at eight o'clock, will my custom greeting play?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will need to dial 1571 tomorrow morning and record your business greeting one more time to populate the fresh partition.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will re-record it at eight o'clock tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your account notes with a priority audit flag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I close this file, what was that mobile telephone number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I told you earlier, it is 07700 900882.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, the mobile number is attached to the ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will test the voicemail tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also applied a ten-pound goodwill credit to your mobile account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for the credit, but the priority is having a professional voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other cellular issue I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that is all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.text: Goodbye.
